en.headline: Boy, 7, suffers minor injury after KMB bus wheel detaches in Cheung Sha Wan
en.dek: A rear-left wheel came off a route 86 double-decker outside Cheung Sha Wan Plaza on Tuesday afternoon, struck a railing and hit the child waiting at a bus stop.
body: A seven-year-old boy sustained minor injuries on Tuesday afternoon after a rear wheel detached from a Kowloon Motor Bus double-decker and struck him at a bus stop in Cheung Sha Wan.

Police received a report at 3.25pm that the route 86 bus was travelling along Cheung Sha Wan Road towards Kwai Chung when its rear-left wheel came off just outside Cheung Sha Wan Plaza. The wheel struck and dented a metal railing, which then hit the boy as he waited for a bus with his mother. He was conscious, complained of soreness in his left thigh and was taken to Caritas Medical Centre.

The 49-year-old driver continued for a short distance before stopping. He passed an alcohol test. A KMB spokesman said the driver had inspected the vehicle before duty and reported no problems. The bus was towed to the Police Vehicle Detention and Examination Centre in Kowloon Bay for a mechanical inspection.

zh.headline: 九巴長沙灣車胎甩脫擊傷七歲男童
zh.dek: 一輛86線雙層巴士周二下午在長沙灣廣場外左後車輪甩脫，撞向欄杆後擊中在巴士站候車的男童，男童輕傷。
body: 一名七歲男童周二下午在長沙灣巴士站被九巴雙層巴士甩脫的車胎擊中，受輕傷。
警方下午3時25分接報，一輛86線巴士沿長沙灣道往葵涌方向行駛，行至長沙灣廣場外時左後車輪突然甩脫，車胎撞向金屬欄杆後再擊中與母親一起候車的男童。男童清醒，左大腿感到疼痛，被送往明愛醫院治理。
49歲姓梁司機繼續行駛一段短距離後停車，酒精測試呈陰性。九巴發言人表示，司機出車前已檢查車輛，並無發現問題。巴士已被拖往九龍灣警察扣車及驗車中心作機械檢驗。
